update_policy: Manual; app does not fetch sources during conversation.

pedagogy.name: IES What Works Clearinghouse: Organizing Instruction and Study to Improve Student Learning
pedagogy.license: Publisher copyright; only citation metadata and original summary reused
pedagogy.scope: Guide for instructional practice, with graded evidence for spacing, worked examples, testing and explanatory questions.
pedagogy.use: Offer a worked example, then a short attempt and later recall. Adapt to the learner's request; do not claim guaranteed learning.
pedagogy.reuse: Metadata and original summary only; no guide text or figures bundled.

pedagogy.name: Cepeda et al.: Distributed practice in verbal recall tasks
pedagogy.license: Publisher copyright; only citation metadata and original summary reused
pedagogy.scope: Review and quantitative synthesis of spacing effects in verbal recall experiments.
pedagogy.use: Suggest revisiting a topic after a delay; the app's 1/3/7-day intervals are a heuristic, not a validated personal optimum.
pedagogy.reuse: Citation metadata and original summary only.

pedagogy.name: Hattie and Timperley: The Power of Feedback
pedagogy.license: Publisher copyright; only citation metadata and original summary reused
pedagogy.scope: Research review on feedback and learning.
pedagogy.use: Correct the reasoning specifically and give an actionable next step without inferring ability or character.
pedagogy.reuse: Citation metadata and original summary only.

academic_and_labor_sources.name: INEP Censo da Educação Superior: microdados
academic_and_labor_sources.license: Public government catalog metadata; dataset terms must be checked separately
academic_and_labor_sources.scope: Higher education institutions, courses, entrants, enrolments and graduates; education supply and participation, not job demand.
academic_and_labor_sources.use: Point to the appropriate observed education source and state the dataset year.
academic_and_labor_sources.reuse: Source catalog only. Check the specific dataset's download terms before importing any data.

academic_and_labor_sources.name: MTE Novo Caged / PDET
academic_and_labor_sources.license: Public government catalog metadata; dataset terms must be checked separately
academic_and_labor_sources.scope: Formal employment admissions and dismissals compiled from administrative systems; not all work or a forecast of vacancies.
academic_and_labor_sources.use: Point to the observed formal-employment source and distinguish it from vacancies or a forecast.
academic_and_labor_sources.reuse: Source catalog only. Identified worker records are not bundled or imported.
